manifest.name: SECS 2R room correction
manifest.description: Calculates the room correction of a SECS 2R project with the SECS 2R engine and applies it to players as a convolution filter.

project.label: SECS 2R project
project.description: Full path of a 2.0 project (.secs) on the server, with its .irs folder next to it. Measure and set it up in the SECS 2R application.

players.label: Players
players.description: The players that get the correction. Save the settings before you press a button.

apply.label: Calculate and apply
apply.description: Calculates the correction of the saved project and puts it in the DSP settings of the saved players, replacing a correction applied before.

remove.label: Remove the correction
remove.description: Removes the correction of this plugin from the DSP settings of the saved players.
